Players Committee card image of [[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2 image; errata mark “E1”), printing: Light Side: “If you control with a spy, may use 2 Force to release Leia here (retrieve 1 Force).” Dark Side: “If [Set 20] Leia is about to leave table (for any reason, even if inactive), imprison her here instead.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e9980f9/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstardetentionblockcorridor.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/deathstardetentionblockcorridor.png] as of commit e9980f9 “Set 20 Errata, 2020 AIs, and a few fixes” (11 December 2022).
